title: On periodic homotopy and homology equivalences of spaces
summary: There are at least two ways to approach the homotopy theory of spaces `at chromatic height $n$': one may localize with respect to $T(n)$-homology or with respect to $v_n$-periodic homotopy groups. It was already observed by Bousfield that these two options yield rather different results. We build on his work to prove precise comparison results between the two notions.
